legalName: Petition to Restrict Access to Criminal History Record Information for an Arrest on a Fugitive From Justice Warrant
boundCodifiedTextRole: codified-text source only - the controlling Georgia legal review, whose Part 3 custom-pleading specification grounds the caption structure, pleading title, citations, proposed-order requirements and certificate of service; it is not included in the packet
routeSelectionNote: The composed pages carry no election control. The statutory route is stated in the instrument's own title and body, which is where this family's route determination lives. No participant-facing election is route-determined on this family.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the arrest on the fugitive warrant
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the arrest on the fugitive warrant
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were arrested on the fugitive warrant, from your Georgia criminal history report - the report identifies the arrest cycle

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County named in the caption - the county where the arrest on the fugitive warrant occurred; this petition is filed in the Superior Court of that county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County named in the caption - the county where the arrest on the fugitive warrant occurred; this petition is filed in the Superior Court of that county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court handled the case, and its level - State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal - is data the participant's own case papers carry; the packet must not default to Superior Court
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Georgia county where you were arrested on the fugitive warrant - O.C.G.A. Sec. 35-3-37(j)(5) sends this petition to the Superior Court of that county

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record, if one was given
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the existing criminal case, exactly as it appears on the court record, if one was given
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the filing is made in the existing criminal case under the existing case number, and that number lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Georgia case number given to the fugitive warrant matter, if one was given - it helps the clerk locate the matter, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The state or jurisdiction that had asked for the defendant to be held
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The state or jurisdiction that had asked for the defendant to be held
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no interstate fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which other state or jurisdiction had asked for you to be held, from the warrant papers or the court record of the fugitive warrant proceeding

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: GCIC Offender Tracking Number (OTN) for the case, where known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the OTN lives on the criminal history record, which the platform never collects, inspects or authenticates
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the GCIC OTN for the case, copied from your Georgia criminal history report where it appears - the proposed order needs it to be actionable by GCIC, and the packet is usable without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of how this arrest on your record has been a barrier
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of how this arrest on your record has been a barrier
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prompts for and formats the participant's own account; it does not write the privacy-harm narrative
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of how the arrest has been a barrier - these lines are yours alone and nothing on them is written for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of what happened with the fugitive warrant and any extradition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of what happened with the fugitive warrant and any extradition

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: in your own words, what happened with the fugitive warrant and any extradition - this is your own account; the packet does not analyse the extradition posture and does not advise on the demanding state's case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and service address of the arresting law enforcement agency served

requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Method used to serve each recipient, chosen from those the certificate lists
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which method the participant uses is settled only when service actually happens
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how you actually served each recipient - certified mail, e-filing or hand delivery - confirmed with the clerk of the court named in the caption before filing, because local courts control their own filing and e-filing practice
